why: A rematch no longer resets the pips arm's starting stock (issue #230). Straight after the reset it is invisible -- the pip count takes the larger of the old start and the current stock, so 5 stocks still draw 5 pips -- which is why the case goes on to lose one: counted against the old match's 3, an entry at 4 draws 4 pips and none lost instead of 5 with one hollow.
killedBy: hud: stock-loss cue arms (issue #230) a rematch that resets stocks upward is not a loss, and starts a new pip count
